description: Create a financial transaction between accounts — debit, credit, or transfer.

idempotency_key.description: UUID used to deduplicate retried requests; requests with the same key return the original result without re-executing

transaction_type.description: Type of transaction: debit, credit, or transfer

scheduled_at.description: Optional ISO8601 datetime to schedule the transaction; if omitted, executes immediately

fee.description: Optional fee associated with this transaction

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the fee

bearer.description: Who bears the fee: sender, receiver, or split

exchange_rate.description: Optional exchange rate details used when the from and to accounts hold different currencies

provider.description: Name of the exchange rate provider

locked_until.description: ISO8601 datetime until which the rate is guaranteed

compliance.description: Optional compliance and regulatory information for the transaction

purpose_code.description: Regulatory purpose code (e.g. SUPP for supplier payment, SALA for salary)

source_of_funds.description: Declared source of funds: salary, savings, investment, or other

sanctions_check_id.description: Optional ID of an external sanctions screening check result

limits.description: Optional limit thresholds to validate the transaction against before execution

daily_limit.description: Maximum cumulative transfer amount allowed per day for the from account

per_transaction_limit.description: Maximum amount allowed for a single transaction

notification.description: Optional notification configuration for transaction events

notify_sender.description: Whether to notify the sender account holder on completion

notify_receiver.description: Whether to notify the receiver account holder on completion

channels.description: Channels to use for notifications: email, sms, or push

tags.description: Optional tags for categorising or searching transactions

metadata.description: Optional arbitrary key-value metadata attached to the transaction
